verdict.rationale: Together AI documents LoRA and full fine-tuning on its platform, plus a full lifecycle of data upload, training, hosting and inference. Dedicated endpoints can deploy "a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model," so the serving half of the story is covered for models trained on Together. Nothing in the evidence shows uploading externally trained weights or bring-your-own LoRA adapters, which is the core of the story as written. missing for 10: documented upload/import of custom model weights trained elsewhere, upload of external LoRA adapters for serving, independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-model serving.
